```plato

// A triangle mesh partitioned into sections. Sections are non-overlapping,
// sorted ascending by FaceRange.Start, and together cover every face.
type SegmentedMesh3D
    implements IValue, IMesh3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Mesh: TriangleMesh3D;
    Sections: Array<MeshSection>;
}

//==
// # Volumetric meshes
//
// Indexed volume elements over a shared vertex array: the tetrahedral and
// hexahedral cell records and the meshes built from them, as used by
// finite-element and structured simulation volumes.

// The four vertex indices of one tetrahedron
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tetrahedron), ordered so the signed volume is
// positive (D on the counter-clockwise side of triangle A-B-C).
type TetrahedronCell
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    A: VertexIndex;
    B: VertexIndex;
    C: VertexIndex;
    D: VertexIndex;
}

// An indexed tetrahedral mesh: finite-element volumes, volumetric
// simulations. ToTriangleMesh yields the boundary surface.
type TetrahedralMesh3D
    implements IValue, IMesh3D, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    Cells: Array<TetrahedronCell>;
}

// The eight vertex indices of one hexahedron
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hexahedron). A, B, C, D form the bottom quad
// wound counter-clockwise when viewed from outside (below); E, F, G, H are the
// corresponding vertices of the top quad (E above A, and so on).
type HexahedronCell
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    A: VertexIndex;
    B: VertexIndex;
    C: VertexIndex;
    D: VertexIndex;
    E: VertexIndex;
    F: VertexIndex;
    G: VertexIndex;
    H: VertexIndex;
}

// An indexed hexahedral mesh: structured simulation volumes, voxel-like
// finite elements with shared vertices.
type HexahedralMesh3D
    implements IValue, IDeformable3D
{
    Positions: Array<Point3D>;
    Cells: Array<HexahedronCell>;
}
```
